name: no_failed_continues_charging
formula: AG (ResponseCode = FAILED -> AX (proto_state = SessionStop | proto_state = proto_state))
description: After a FAILED response, the session must eventually stop

name: stop_requires_power_delivery
formula: AG (proto_state = AC_ChargeLoop & ChargeProgress = Stop -> AX (proto_state = PowerDelivery | proto_state = AC_ChargeLoop))
description: ChargeProgress=Stop from charge loop must go to PowerDelivery

name: no_backward_SessionSetup_to_SupportedAppProtocol
formula: AG (proto_state = SessionSetup -> AX proto_state != SupportedAppProtocol)
description: No backward transition from SessionSetup to SupportedAppProtocol

name: eventually_terminates
formula: AG (proto_state = SupportedAppProtocol -> AF proto_state = SessionStop)
description: Every session eventually reaches SessionStop

name: rc_restrict_ServiceDetail
formula: AG (proto_state = ServiceDetail -> (ResponseCode = OK | ResponseCode = FAILED_ServiceIDInvalid))
description: In ServiceDetail, ResponseCode must be one of: OK, FAILED_ServiceIDInvalid

name: rc_restrict_ServiceSelection
formula: AG (proto_state = ServiceSelection -> (ResponseCode = OK | ResponseCode = FAILED_ServiceSelectionInvalid))
description: In ServiceSelection, ResponseCode must be one of: OK, FAILED_ServiceSelectionInvalid

name: rc_restrict_AC_ChargeParameterDiscovery
formula: AG (proto_state = AC_ChargeParameterDiscovery -> (ResponseCode = FAILED_WrongChargeParameter))
description: In AC_ChargeParameterDiscovery, ResponseCode must be one of: FAILED_WrongChargeParameter

name: rc_restrict_ScheduleExchange
formula: AG (proto_state = ScheduleExchange -> (ResponseCode = OK | ResponseCode = WARNING_EVPowerProfileViolation | ResponseCode = FAILED_EVPowerProfileViolation))
description: In ScheduleExchange, ResponseCode must be one of: OK, WARNING_EVPowerProfileViolation, FAILED_EVPowerProfileViolation

name: rc_restrict_PowerDelivery
formula: AG (proto_state = PowerDelivery -> (ResponseCode = OK | ResponseCode = WARNING_StandbyNotAllowed))
description: In PowerDelivery, ResponseCode must be one of: OK, WARNING_StandbyNotAllowed

name: rc_restrict_AC_ChargeLoop
formula: AG (proto_state = AC_ChargeLoop -> (ResponseCode = WARNING_EVPowerProfileViolation | ResponseCode = FAILED_EVPowerProfileViolation))
description: In AC_ChargeLoop, ResponseCode must be one of: WARNING_EVPowerProfileViolation, FAILED_EVPowerProfileViolation

name: rc_restrict_SessionStop
formula: AG (proto_state = SessionStop -> (ResponseCode = OK | ResponseCode = FAILED | ResponseCode = WARNING))
description: In SessionStop, ResponseCode must be one of: OK, FAILED, WARNING

name: constrain_Authorization_EVSEProcessing
formula: AG (proto_state = Authorization -> (EVSEProcessing = Finished | EVSEProcessing = Ongoing))
description: In Authorization, EVSEProcessing constrained to: Finished, Ongoing

name: constrain_CertificateInstallation_EVSEProcessing
formula: AG (proto_state = CertificateInstallation -> (EVSEProcessing = Finished | EVSEProcessing = ONGOING | EVSEProcessing = Ongoing))
description: In CertificateInstallation, EVSEProcessing constrained to: Finished, ONGOING, Ongoing

name: constrain_ServiceDiscovery_ServiceRenegotiationSupported
formula: AG (proto_state = ServiceDiscovery -> (ServiceRenegotiationSupported = e_True))
description: In ServiceDiscovery, ServiceRenegotiationSupported constrained to: True

name: constrain_ScheduleExchange_EVSEProcessing
formula: AG (proto_state = ScheduleExchange -> (EVSEProcessing = Finished | EVSEProcessing = Ongoing))
description: In ScheduleExchange, EVSEProcessing constrained to: Finished, Ongoing

name: constrain_PowerDelivery_EVSEProcessing
formula: AG (proto_state = PowerDelivery -> (EVSEProcessing = NOT_APPLICABLE))
description: In PowerDelivery, EVSEProcessing constrained to: NOT_APPLICABLE

name: constrain_PowerDelivery_EVProcessing
formula: AG (proto_state = PowerDelivery -> (EVProcessing = Ongoing))
description: In PowerDelivery, EVProcessing constrained to: Ongoing

name: constrain_PowerDelivery_ChargeProgress
formula: AG (proto_state = PowerDelivery -> (ChargeProgress = Standby | ChargeProgress = Stop))
description: In PowerDelivery, ChargeProgress constrained to: Standby, Stop

name: constrain_SessionStop_EVSENotification
formula: AG (proto_state = SessionStop -> (EVSENotification = Terminate))
description: In SessionStop, EVSENotification constrained to: Terminate

name: constrain_SessionStop_ServiceRenegotiationSupported
formula: AG (proto_state = SessionStop -> (ServiceRenegotiationSupported = e_True))
description: In SessionStop, ServiceRenegotiationSupported constrained to: True

name: constrain_SessionStop_ChargingSession
formula: AG (proto_state = SessionStop -> (ChargingSession = Pause | ChargingSession = ServiceRenegotiation | ChargingSession = Terminate))
description: In SessionStop, ChargingSession constrained to: Pause, ServiceRenegotiation, Terminate
